# Amalfi.Day: key facts

> Evergreen facts from the Amalfi.Day guide pages, written by Gregory (Greg), a photographer and apartment host living in Atrani on the Amalfi Coast. Prices and schedules change by season; each page on the site shows when it was last checked. Last reviewed: November 2026.

## About

- Amalfi.Day is the brand of CristallPont S.R.L., Traversa Dragone 2, 84010 Atrani (SA), Italy. VAT 05863730650.
- Contact: hello@amalfi.day, +39 327 0972329 (WhatsApp).
- Services: photoshoots (solo, couple, family, proposals), private car tours, scooter photo tours, apartments and rooms in Atrani.
- Atrani sits next to Amalfi. The walk from Amalfi takes about 10 minutes along the waterfront and through a pedestrian tunnel.

## Getting to Atrani and Amalfi (https://amalfi.day/directions/, https://amalfi.day/how-to-get/)

- Public transport route: train from Napoli Centrale to Salerno, then ferry (about 35 minutes, from EUR 12) or SITA bus line 5120 (about 75 minutes) to Amalfi, then walk 10 minutes to Atrani.
- Direct airport shuttle: Pintour runs from Naples Capodichino Airport to Amalfi, stopping at Vietri, Cetara, Maiori, Minori, Ravello/Castiglione and Atrani. EUR 20 per adult, EUR 10 per child, about 2h 15m to 2h 40m.
- Taxi from Naples Airport to the Amalfi Coast: from EUR 180 per car.
- Late arrivals: after about 19:30 ferries and buses thin out. For flights landing after 21:00, book a transfer or sleep in Naples or Salerno.
- Driving from Naples: the easiest route is via Vietri sul Mare (mostly motorway, then about 40 minutes on the coastal road). Via Sorrento is scenic but congested near Positano. Via the Chiunzi pass and Ravello is the most demanding.
- Amalfi Porters carry luggage from Amalfi port or bus station to Atrani by golf cart, from EUR 20 per person, every day 7:00-20:00.

## Buses (https://amalfi.day/timetables/)

- SITA Sud lines: 5120 Amalfi-Atrani-Minori-Maiori-Cetara-Vietri-Salerno; 5070 Amalfi-Conca-Praiano-Positano-Sorrento; 5110 Amalfi-Ravello-Scala; 5080 Amalfi-Agerola-Castellammare-Napoli; 5020 Amalfi-Vietri-Nocera-Napoli; 5010 Maiori-Tramonti-Nocera-Salerno.
- Departure times are published by SITA as PDF timetables, linked from the page. The PDFs were last checked on October 4, 2026.
- Buy tickets before boarding at a Tabacchi shop with the "T" sign and validate on board. Fares: from EUR 1.60 for short rides along the coast to about EUR 3 from Amalfi to Salerno.
- Amico Shuttle Amalfi-Ravello: EUR 10 one way, EUR 16 return, children 0-3 free, no luggage allowed.

## Ferries (https://amalfi.day/ferry-timetables/)

- Operators covered: Travelmar, Grassi Junior Ferries and NLG, plus PositanoJet and Alicost links.
- Travelmar Salerno to Amalfi: about 35 minutes (60 minutes on trips via Cetara and Maiori), EUR 12. Amalfi to Positano: 25 minutes, EUR 10. Salerno to Positano: 70 minutes, EUR 17.
- Grassi Junior: luggage EUR 3, bike or pet EUR 5. Routes include Salerno, Amalfi, Positano, Cetara, Maiori, Minori and Capri.
- NLG: most 2026 routes run from 1 April to 3 November, linking Amalfi with Capri, Sorrento, Naples Beverello, Salerno, Castellammare di Stabia and Positano.
- Ferries are seasonal and weather dependent. Always recheck the operator on the day.

## Parking (https://amalfi.day/parking/)

- Amalfi, Luna Rossa garage: 170 car and 30 motorbike spaces, EUR 2-4 per hour, from EUR 40 per day. A tunnel links it to Atrani.
- Atrani: June to September, non-residents pay EUR 3 per hour with a 4-hour maximum (08:00-20:00); parking is banned overnight from 23:00 to 08:00. Not a practical base for a car.
- Positano: blue zones EUR 3 per hour; central garages EUR 8-12 per hour, EUR 50-90 per day; free parking in Nocelle or Montepertuso with a bus down.
- Ravello, Auditorium car park: EUR 4 per hour (08:00-24:00), EUR 2.50 per hour overnight, 80 spaces.
- Praiano blue zones: EUR 3 per hour year-round; day passes EUR 15 for 6 hours, EUR 30 for 14 hours.
- Cheapest base: Vietri sul Mare (EUR 1.50-2 per hour), then ferry or bus along the coast.
- ZTL (limited traffic zones) operate in Amalfi, Positano, Ravello and Atrani. Fines start from EUR 150.
- Blue lines are paid parking, white lines are usually residents only, yellow lines are for local services.

## Beaches (https://amalfi.day/beaches/)

- 11 beaches reviewed: Vietri sul Mare, Erchie, Maiori, Minori, Castiglione, Atrani, Amalfi, Conca dei Marini, Furore fjord, Praiano (Marina di Praia) and Positano.
- Season runs from around Easter to the first weeks of November. The sea is warmest from June to September, around 26-28°C.
- Most beaches are pebbly. A standard rental is two loungers and one umbrella. Every beach keeps a free public strip.
- Maiori has the longest beach on the coast; Vietri sul Mare the widest and most accessible. Castiglione, Ravello's beach, is reached by about 120 steps.

## Motorbike roads (https://amalfi.day/moto/)

- Tramonti Valley route: 42.4 km from Atrani through Ravello and Tramonti to the Valico di Chiunzi viewpoint and down to Minori. GPX and KMZ files available.
- Amalfi to Agerola route: 25.7 km above Conca dei Marini to Agerola and the start of the Path of the Gods. GPX and KMZ files available.

## Photoshoots (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/)

- Solo: Mini 30 minutes, 20 photos, EUR 200; Signature 60 minutes, 60 photos, EUR 300; Coastal Story 120 minutes, 120 photos, EUR 480.
- Couple: Mini 30 minutes, 20 photos, EUR 250; Signature 60 minutes, 60 photos, EUR 350; Coastal Story 120 minutes, 120 photos, EUR 550.
- Greg is based in Atrani and also photographs in Amalfi, Ravello, Positano, Maiori and Tramonti. Atrani and Amalfi are in the base travel zone; other towns add a travel fee.
- Posing help is included throughout the session. A free pose guide is at poses.amalfi.day. Greg speaks English, Italian and Russian.
- Retouched photos are delivered in a private online gallery within 7 business days. Rain on the day means a free reschedule.
- Town photographer pages: Amalfi (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/amalfi-photographer/), Atrani (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/atrani-photographer/), Conca dei Marini (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/conca-dei-marini-photographer/), Maiori (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/maiori-photographer/), Positano (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/positano-photographer/), Praiano (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/praiano-photographer/), Ravello (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/ravello-photographer/), Sorrento (https://amalfi.day/photoshootings/sorrento-photographer/).

## Tours (https://amalfi.day/experience/)

- Private car tours: Scenic Coast (Sorrento, Positano, Amalfi, Ravello) EUR 400 up to 3 hours, EUR 600 for 4-6 hours. Peak Flavors (Tramonti Valley farms and wineries) EUR 450 / EUR 650. Custom itineraries from EUR 550.
- Scooter photo tour: one rider with a guide who photographs the ride, coastal or mountain route, from EUR 350, 40-70 edited photos, helmet and insurance included.
